FIELD.NAME: course
FIELD.COMMENT: Course the activity belongs to

FIELD.NAME: name
FIELD.COMMENT: Activity name

FIELD.NAME: intro
FIELD.COMMENT: Activity description

FIELD.NAME: introformat
FIELD.COMMENT: Format of the intro field

FIELD.NAME: language
FIELD.COMMENT: BCP-47-ish language/script code of the exercise content, e.g. de, fr, ko, zh-Hans, ja, sa, ru. Drives script_handler_manager routing (see classes/local/grading). No schema-level DEFAULT: a CHAR NOT NULL column must have either a meaningful default or none — Moodle's XMLDB validator rejects an empty-string default and would auto-correct it to NULL at debugging() severity. Application code always supplies this value explicitly on insert.

FIELD.NAME: currentversionid
FIELD.COMMENT: Points at the published elang_version currently shown to learners. Deliberately NOT a declared foreign key: elang_version.elangid already references elang.id, and a second, opposite-direction foreign key would create a circular DDL dependency. The relationship is enforced in application code (classes/local/domain/version_manager.php).

TABLE.NAME: elang_version
TABLE.COMMENT: Immutable exercise versions. Editing content publishes a new version; existing attempts stay linked to the version they were started on, so content edits never alter or remove learner data (see Lastenheft P0.1 / P3).

FIELD.NAME: versionnumber
FIELD.COMMENT: Sequential per elangid, starting at 1

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: draft | published | archived

FIELD.NAME: contenthash
FIELD.COMMENT: SHA-1 over the normalised version content; cache key for rendered worksheets and player payloads. No schema-level DEFAULT, same rationale as elang.language above.

TABLE.NAME: elang_cue
TABLE.COMMENT: Transcript segments (cues) belonging to one exercise version

FIELD.NAME: cuekey
FIELD.COMMENT: Identity that stays stable across versions of the same elangid, so responses recorded against an older version can be related to the same cue in a newer version (see 2.1-2, retroactive answer-variant acceptance)

TABLE.NAME: elang_gap
TABLE.COMMENT: A gap within a cue's transcript text

FIELD.NAME: gapkey
FIELD.COMMENT: Identity that stays stable across versions, same rationale as elang_cue.cuekey

FIELD.NAME: charstart
FIELD.COMMENT: Character offset of the gap within elang_cue.transcript

FIELD.NAME: solution
FIELD.COMMENT: Primary model answer. Never included in External Function payloads sent to the player (see Lastenheft P12).

FIELD.NAME: gradingalgorithm
FIELD.COMMENT: exact | wordrecognized — the acceptance threshold used to decide whether a response counts as correct; see classes/local/grading/answer_evaluator.php

FIELD.NAME: maxlength
FIELD.COMMENT: Optional hard server-side response-length limit for this gap. Null defers to a site-wide default enforced by the not-yet-implemented attempt API (phase 3); this field lets an individual gap override that default once it exists.

FIELD.NAME: linkurl
FIELD.COMMENT: Optional supplementary resource, validated as PARAM_URL/moodle_url on save, never taken verbatim from subtitle markup (see Lastenheft, ungeprüfte Links aus Untertiteltexten)

TABLE.NAME: elang_gapanswer
TABLE.COMMENT: Accepted answer variants for a gap, in addition to elang_gap.solution

FIELD.NAME: isregex
FIELD.COMMENT: 0 or 1. Regular-expression variants are matched with preg_match regardless of gradingalgorithm and require mod/elang:useregex; see classes/local/grading.

TABLE.NAME: elang_gaphint
TABLE.COMMENT: Graded hint levels for a gap

FIELD.NAME: hinttype
FIELD.COMMENT: text | firstletter | wordlength | partial | solution | translation (translation reserved for 2.1-4)

TABLE.NAME: elang_attempt
TABLE.COMMENT: One attempt at an exercise by one user, pinned to the version they attempted

FIELD.NAME: state
FIELD.COMMENT: inprogress | finished | abandoned

FIELD.NAME: exactgaps
FIELD.COMMENT: Gaps solved with the exact algorithm outcome, regardless of the gap's configured acceptance threshold

FIELD.NAME: correctgaps
FIELD.COMMENT: Gaps accepted as correct under their configured gradingalgorithm (exactgaps is a subset)

TABLE.NAME: elang_response
TABLE.COMMENT: A learner's response to one gap within one attempt

FIELD.NAME: responsetext
FIELD.COMMENT: Kept in full so that a retroactively accepted answer variant (2.1-2) can trigger re-grading without asking the learner again

FIELD.NAME: resultstate
FIELD.COMMENT: exact | wordrecognized | incorrect | empty — the finest classification the evaluator found, independent of the gap's acceptance threshold

FIELD.NAME: accepted
FIELD.COMMENT: 0 or 1. Whether resultstate meets or exceeds the gap's configured gradingalgorithm, i.e. whether it counts as correct
